articles.summary: Welsh crane rental company adds a 300 t capacity GMK6300L-1 and a 250 t capacity GMK5250XL-1, boosting its ability to support a wide range of complex lifting projects across the UK.Strong previous experience with Manitowoc aftersales support influenced the decision to expand the fleet with additional Grove cranes.
articles.title: UK’s Davies Crane Hire strengthens fleet with two high-capacity Grove cranes

articles.summary: A GMK4100L-2 and GMK3060L-1 deliver precise, coordinated lifting in challenging ground conditions and to a tight schedule in Taranto, Italy.Italian crane specialists Servidea Sollevamenti and Gamit are leading construction of the complex steel roof.The cranes’ reliable performance and compact designs enable efficient operations on a constrained jobsite.
articles.title: Two Grove cranes power construction of new arena for the Mediterranean Games 2026

articles.summary: Manitowoc’s Veteran Employee Resource Group led activities across the Shady Grove manufacturing plant, Milwaukee corporate office, and all 17 MGX Equipment Services locations.Employees walked laps, packed backpacks, held branch fundraisers, and purchased limited-edition shirts in support of veterans living with post-traumatic stress disorder.
articles.title: Manitowoc employees unite through “Empowering Warriors & Raising Hope” initiative to support K9s For Warriors

articles.summary: The self-contained Potain Power Solutions provide energy support for the demanding duty cycles and peak power requirements of tower cranes.Their intelligent, on-board energy management reduces fuel consumption and lowers runtime for generators.Potain Power Solutions are compact, transportable, and deliver stable power for tower cranes in even the most challenging environments and jobsites.
articles.title: Manitowoc launches Potain Power Solutions energy systems for emerging markets

articles.summary: As projects become more complex, Potain tower cranes are pushed to perform beyond standard configurations.Manitowoc Lift Solutions combines engineering expertise, field experience, and product support to help customers adapt different crane models for specific applications.
articles.title: How Manitowoc Lift Solutions is redefining Potain tower crane utilization

articles.summary: German crane rental company continues its investment in Grove cranes, strengthening a fleet that already includes a GMK4090-1.The new 200 t capacity all-terrain crane delivers strong, versatile performance across construction, precast concrete assembly, and energy projects.The innovative Grove CONNECT™ telematics system was a key factor in the purchase decision.
articles.title: CST Transporte expands fleet with Grove GMK5200-1 to support high-performance lifting operations

articles.summary: The partnership strengthens nationwide service and coverage for Potain customers across Indonesia.PT Potaindo Machinery will offer full sales and service support for customers, including expanded parts availability to help maximize crane uptime.
articles.title: Potain appoints PT Potaindo Machinery as dealer for Indonesia

articles.summary: J&M Crane & Transport sent a mix of five- and six-axle Grove all-terrain cranes to handle the project.Careful planning and coordination ensured the 12-hour lift passed without a hitch.
articles.title: Four Grove cranes combine for precision container crane installation in London

articles.summary: Four Grove GRT8100-1 cranes and one Grove GRT780 support a major industrial construction project in Antwerp, Belgium.All the cranes were manufactured at Manitowoc’s Niella Tanaro factory in Italy.Manitowoc is providing full parts, service, and maintenance support to the cranes from its Breda facility in The Netherlands.
articles.title: Sarens deploys new Grove rough-terrain cranes on INEOS Project ONE in Belgium

articles.summary: Grove five-axle GMK5150XL and GMK5250XL-1 models join the growing fleet of Wire Cranes to serve projects across the UK.Industry-leading customer support from Manitowoc helps Wire Cranes deliver first-class service to customers.
articles.title: UK’s Wire Cranes continues growth trajectory with Grove additions
